modules.name: Auto-spatialization Default ON
modules.description: Enable the Labs preference at rooted service startup without bypassing thermal or window limits.

modules.name: Bluetooth Xbox Unknown-Key Recovery
modules.description: Release a stuck unknown key on Bluetooth Microsoft Xbox controllers so hand navigation can recover. Does not forward gamepad input to Steam Link.

modules.name: ADB Port Publisher
modules.description: Report the headset's wireless-debugging ADB port to a receiver on your PC whenever the framework assigns it. Requires the receiver and token described in the module README.
